changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingchargeline AS SELECT bcl.id, bcl.charge_id, bcl.patient_service_product_id, bcl.patient_id, bcl.encounter_id, bcl.billing_item_type, bcl.brand_medication_id, bcl.diagnostic_test_id, bcl.service_id, bcl.procedure_id, bcl.item_code, bcl.item_description, bcl.service_source, bcl.source_id, bcl.quantity, bcl.unit_price, bcl.gross_amount, bcl.discount_amount, bcl.exemption_amount, bcl.tax_amount, bcl.net_amount, bcl.patient_responsibility_amount, bcl.insurance_responsibility_amount, bcl.other_payer_responsibility_amount, bcl.allocated_amount, bcl.outstanding_amount, bcl.reserved_amount, bcl.currency, bcl.status, bcl.current_pricing_snapshot_id, bcl.patient_insurance_id, bcl.pre_authorization_required, bcl.pre_authorization_status, bcl.pre_authorization_request_id, bcl.pre_authorization_reference_no, bcl.reversed_charge_line_id, bcl.idempotency_key, bcl.cancelled_date, bcl.cancelled_by, bcl.cancellation_reason, bcl.notes, bcl.created_by, bcl.created_date, bcl.last_modified_by, bcl.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_charge_line bcl;

changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
